title: Claim Evidence Map
description: DISCOVER-stage typed artifact. Output of claim-evidence-linker. Maps each claim to the concrete evidence loci (table cell, figure, code block, dataset row) that support or refute it. Every mapping must have at least one non-empty locus — a claim with no locus cannot be citation-checked.

claim_id.description: must match a claim_id from a claim_list

loci.description: at least one locus is required — empty loci means the claim is unanchored

reported_result.description: The actual value or statement found at this locus. The claim-evidence-linker READS this to decide supports_claim for the locus (true = supports the claim, false = contradicts it). There is NO automatic numeric comparison: contradiction detection is the linker's explicit supports_claim decision, enforced deterministically by the gate. Always populate this for table cells, figures, and code comments so the linker can judge support correctly.

supports_claim.description: REQUIRED. The linker must explicitly decide per locus: true = this locus supports the claim; false = this locus contradicts the claim (reports the opposite). No default — omitting this field causes citation_checker.py to conservatively BLOCK (cannot verify the claim).
